featureRef: 3.1 View and maintain the student record
name: View and maintain the student record
priorityReason: The single source of truth for a student. Attendance, fees, examinations and reporting all read it.

goal.capability: to open a student's record and keep its details accurate
goal.outcome: one correct record serves every module, so a correction made once appears everywhere

secondaryActors.involvement: Opens the record and corrects details after admission, and uploads missing or replacement documents.
Reads the records of students in their own assigned sections only, and cannot edit them.
Reads the records of students in the classes they supervise.
Reads and maintains every record in their branch, and is the only role that may change identity fields.
Is the source of most changes, but does not edit here. Changes are reported to the office, or submitted through the portal where that is enabled.

additional.description: An admission is approved and the record comes into existence.
A migration creates records when a school first goes live.
A guardian submits a change of detail through the parent portal for Staff to apply.

preconditions.condition: The student record already exists. It is created on approval, or by bulk import; there is no screen that creates a student by typing (BR-1).
The acting user's role permits reaching that student, within their branch and their own row scope.

postConditions: The record holds the corrected details, and every module that shows the student reads the same corrected values.
Each change is in the audit log with the field, the previous value, the new value, the user and the timestamp.
Any document uploaded is held against the record and is available wherever the student's documents are listed.
Once the student is placed in a class the record appears on the Enrolled Student List rather than the Registered Student List.
Identity fields are unchanged unless a School Admin changed them, since other modules key off them.
Medical information is unchanged. It is not held on this record and is reachable only through its own restricted screen.
No student record is created or deleted here. Creation happens at admission, and a record is deactivated rather than removed.

businessRules.rule: A student record is never created by typing. It comes into existence when an admission is approved, or through migration when a school first goes live. Any other route would bypass the inquiry, review, approval and eligibility checks that admission exists to enforce.
This record is the single source of truth for the student. A correction made here appears everywhere the student is shown — attendance, fees, examinations, timetable and reporting.
Every change is written to the audit log with the field changed, the previous value, the new value, the user and the timestamp.

Student ID, roll number, identity number and date of birth are identity fields and may be changed by School Admin only, because other modules key off them and a change ripples through fee, examination and attendance history.
An identity field change requires a written reason. It is the kind of change that has to be defensible afterwards.
Changing the guardian's contact changes the contact they sign in and receive messages on. It is not merely a display value.
Medical information is not held on this record. The profile links to the student's medical record, which opens only for the roles its own restricted access permits.
Class and section are shown here but are not changed here. Placement is its own act, so a child is never moved between sections as a side effect of correcting an address.
A Teacher reads only the students in their own assigned sections, and identity numbers are not shown to them. They need to know who is in their class, not a child's B-Form number.
A guardian does not edit the record. Changes are reported to the office and entered by Staff, or submitted through the portal for Staff to apply, so every change has a school user behind it.
A record is deactivated, never deleted. A record referenced by a financial transaction cannot be deactivated at all.
Once a student is placed in a class the record moves from the Registered Student List to the Enrolled Student List.

transitions.condition: The student is placed in a class and section (BR-12).

basicFlow.navigation: Login → Student → Enrolled Student List, or Login → Global search
basicFlow.userAction: Opens the student from a list or by searching for them.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Shows the profile within the acting user's row scope, or refuses where the student is outside it.
Shows personal, guardian and placement details, the documents from admission, and a link to the medical record rather than its contents.

basicFlow.userAction: Corrects the fields their role permits.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Validates each field, and refuses any identity field the role may not change.

basicFlow.userAction: Changes an identity field, giving a written reason.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Validates the new value, records the reason, and applies the change everywhere the field is keyed on.

basicFlow.userAction: Uploads a missing or replacement document.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Validates the file by type and size and lists it against the record.
Writes each change to the audit log with its previous and new value.
Makes the corrected values visible wherever the student appears, across attendance, fees, examinations, timetable and reporting.

alternateFlows.condition: A Teacher opens a student in their own section
alternateFlows.navigation: Login → Student → Enrolled Student List → Student profile
alternateFlows.behaviour: The profile opens read only, without identity numbers, since a teacher needs to know who is in their class rather than a child's B-Form number (BR-9).

alternateFlows.condition: A guardian reports a change of address or contact
alternateFlows.behaviour: Staff enter the change on the guardian's behalf, so every change has a school user behind it (BR-10).

alternateFlows.condition: A guardian submits a change through the parent portal
alternateFlows.navigation: Login → Student → Pending detail changes → Student profile → Edit
alternateFlows.behaviour: The submitted change is presented for Staff to apply or refuse. It does not reach the record on its own (BR-10).

alternateFlows.condition: The user needs the student's medical information
alternateFlows.behaviour: The medical record opens under its own restricted access. It is never displayed on this profile (BR-7).

alternateFlows.condition: The guardian's contact number has changed
alternateFlows.behaviour: The new number replaces the guardian's sign-in and messaging contact, and the previous value stays in the audit log (BR-6).

alternateFlows.condition: The student has not yet been placed in a class
alternateFlows.navigation: Login → Student → Registered Student List → Student profile
alternateFlows.behaviour: The record is on the Registered Student List and shows no class or section. It moves to the Enrolled Student List once placed (BR-12).

conventionsApplied.name: session-and-authentication
conventionsApplied.rule: Every use case except the login use case assumes an authenticated session. Sign out is available on every screen. An expired or invalid session returns the user to the login screen with the message "Your session has ended. Please sign in again."

conventionsApplied.name: role-based-access
conventionsApplied.rule: Access is enforced server-side on every request, not only by hiding menu items. A request for a record outside the actor's permitted scope returns a 403 and the message "You do not have permission to view this record." A use case states additions and restrictions only.

conventionsApplied.name: branch-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every record carries a branch ID. Users see only their own branch unless the use case states otherwise. Super Admin, School Admin and Principal may switch branch from the header.

conventionsApplied.name: academic-session-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every academic record carries an academic session ID. Lists default to the current open session.

conventionsApplied.name: list-screens
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list supports search, column sort and page-size selection. Default page size 25; default sort is most recent first. Filters are applied before printing or exporting.

conventionsApplied.name: print-and-pdf
conventionsApplied.rule: Every report and list offers Print and Download as PDF, honouring the filters currently applied. Each output carries the school name, branch, academic session, report title, filter summary, generation timestamp and the name of the user who generated it.

conventionsApplied.name: audit-trail
conventionsApplied.rule: Every create, update, deactivation, approval and reversal writes to the audit log: actor, role, timestamp, record type, record ID, before and after values, and IP address. Audit entries are never editable.

conventionsApplied.name: deletion
conventionsApplied.rule: Records are deactivated, not physically removed. Deactivated records are excluded from lists and lookups but remain in the audit trail and in historical reports. A record referenced by a financial transaction can never be deactivated.

conventionsApplied.name: validation-and-messages
conventionsApplied.rule: Field-level errors appear inline beneath the field on blur and on submit. Errors that block the whole action appear as a banner at the top of the form. Successful actions show a toast. No action succeeds silently.

conventionsApplied.name: dates-times-numbers
conventionsApplied.rule: Dates display as DD-MM-YYYY; date and time as DD-MM-YYYY HH:mm in 24-hour form. Times are school-local. Phone numbers are stored in the registered mobile format.

conventionsApplied.name: language
conventionsApplied.rule: All user-visible strings come from a resource file. No hard-coded text in any screen.

conventionsApplied.name: screen-states
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list, dashboard tile and report defines four states: loading, empty, error and populated. The empty state names what is missing and links to the action that creates it.

conventionsApplied.name: attachments
conventionsApplied.rule: Uploaded files are limited to 10 MB and to PDF, JPG, PNG, DOCX and XLSX unless a use case states otherwise. File type is validated by content, not by extension.

conventionsApplied.name: notifications
conventionsApplied.rule: All outbound SMS, WhatsApp, email and push messages are sent through the Messaging module, recorded in the sent-message log with per-channel delivery status, and use a named template. Use cases reference the template; they do not embed message text.

conventionsApplied.name: default-performance-and-retention
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise: a screen loads within 2 seconds and a save completes within 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users; lists paginate above 100 rows; financial and student records are retained 7 years; audit and message logs 12 months; every screen is usable at a 360 px viewport. Fill the non-functional field only to depart from this.

conventionsApplied.name: default-trigger
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise, the trigger is: the user navigates to the screen and initiates the action. Fill the Triggers field only where a scheduled job, an event in another module, or an inbound external call also starts it.
